We are seeking a Junior Software Developer for one of our
 **PRIME CONTRACTS** 
 and offers exciting opportunities to support essential services and mission critical activities across the enterprise. Our mission supports the Government Corporate Management Services (CMS) by providing full life cycle support services through the sustainment, modernization, and transformation of the enterprise corporate applications. Come join our diverse and growing team with lots of opportunities!
   

  

* Join an established, high\-performing team responsible for the sustainment, enhancement, and modernization of mission\-critical security applications that support essential operational functions across the enterprise.

Collaborate with developers, technical leads, and stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable, and user\-focused solutions.

* Take ownership of assigned tasks and projects while balancing independent work with collaboration across cross\-functional teams. The ideal candidate is self\-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable contributing both as an individual contributor and as a valued member of a larger development team.
* Engage with technical leads and team members to evaluate emerging technologies, improve development practices, and support the ongoing evolution of critical sustainment systems.
